summary: Use paired HTML blockquote boundaries so current email reply text after a quote is not mislabeled as historical context.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Existing rule that quoted history cannot directly create a current requirement or property
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued email accuracy and adaptability improvements.
known_limitations: Plain-text quote detection remains conservative and depends on explicit reply markers or quoted-line prefixes.
CSS-based visual quoting without semantic blockquote markup is not inferred.
Validation uses synthetic local EML only and makes no model, mailbox or external provider request.
